name: @lit-core/html-aot
description: Ahead-of-time template compiler for Lit and Web Components

scripts.build: cargo build --release --offline && cp target/release/libhtml_aot.dylib html-aot.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null && (codesign -s - -f html-aot.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true) || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build --offline && cp target/debug/libhtml_aot.dylib html-aot.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null && (codesign -s - -f html-aot.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true) || true
